text: There’s an urgency in the repeated phrase, 'and I’m out of here,' echoing around this space that seems built for thought and discovery—R&D, where ideas are born. But right now, I feel caught between worlds: the glass enclosure of innovation and the desire to simply escape. There is an odd contrast between the energy of technological progress and my own impulse to leave. It’s a mixture of curiosity and restlessness, as if I’m pausing on the threshold of insight, yet wanting nothing more than distance.
